details.p: Aveenix Connect is a New Zealand business directory where customers find local businesses, and businesses claim their listing to get found, win work, hire staff and sell products, all from one account.

Probably. Aveenix Connect is built from the official New Zealand business register (NZBN), so most registered NZ businesses are already listed. Search for your business name to find it. If you’d like your listing removed or your personal details hidden, use “Report incorrect information” on your listing or contact us at any time.

details.summary: How much does it cost to claim my listing?
details.p: Nothing. Claiming and verifying your business is free. Optional paid upgrades are available for extra features, such as featured placement and more customer leads.

details.summary: How do I claim my business?
details.p: Search for your business, click “Claim this business”, and confirm you’re authorised to manage it by entering the code we email to the business’s contact address. If you can’t get that email, ask our team to check your claim instead. Once verified, you can update your listing straight away.

details.summary: What do I get when I claim my listing?
details.p: One claimed listing works across the whole Aveenix platform. You can:

ul.li: add your logo, photos, services, hours and service areas
receive quote requests from local customers
post job ads on Aveenix Jobs
sell products on Aveenix Marketplace (coming soon)
earn trust badges, such as Verified Business and Licensed Builder

details.summary: Will my listing show up on Google and AI assistants?
details.p: Every Aveenix listing is built so search engines and AI assistants can easily read it, at no extra cost. No directory can guarantee where you’ll appear, because search engines and AI tools decide that themselves. But a complete, accurate listing gives you the best chance.

details.summary: Is Aveenix Connect free to use?
details.p: Yes. Searching, contacting businesses and requesting quotes is free.

details.summary: How do I know a business is real?
details.p: Every listing comes from the official NZ business register. Look for trust badges, which show a business has been verified or has had its licence checked.
Click “Get quotes”, describe what you need and where, and matching local businesses will contact you.
Reviews can only be left after a real enquiry or job through Aveenix, so you can trust you’re reading about real customer experiences.

details.summary: Do I earn rewards for using Aveenix?
details.p: Yes. You earn Aveenix Rewards and Cashback when you complete a genuine purchase or booking through Aveenix. Rewards are confirmed once the sale is completed. See the Rewards page for details.

details.summary: What if I find wrong information?
details.p: Use the “Report incorrect information” button on any listing, and our team will check it.
